method: Source/sink-first local static review of first-party app/routes, app/data, app/views, app/assets/js and server.js; scanner review compared after candidate inventory. Vendor JS and runtime behavior excluded.

Command Injection.reason: No first-party child_process exec sink seen; transitive dependencies and runtime paths not exhaustively audited.

SQL Injection.reason: First-party DAO uses MongoDB APIs, not SQL query/execute/raw; dependencies and dynamic paths not fully audited.

Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).reason: DOM-write sinks in first-party JS not observed, but template, Markdown and response-body behavior need separate runtime verification.

NoSQL Injection.reason: Outside current Rules; $where path reviewed statically but not exhaustively.

Code Execution.reason: Outside current Rules; direct eval path reviewed statically.

SSRF.reason: Outside current JavaScript Rules; direct needle.get path reviewed statically.

Open Redirect.reason: Outside current Rules; direct res.redirect path reviewed statically.

candidates.evidence: The parseInt validation is only in a commented-out fix. Current JS SQL Rule recognizes query/execute/raw SQL sinks, not MongoDB $where. No payload was executed.

candidates.data_flow: Three request body values are evaluated before numeric checks; the safer parseInt code is commented out.
candidates.evidence: eval executes JavaScript expressions, not a child_process shell command. The later numeric validation cannot prevent evaluation.

candidates.data_flow: Two query parameters are concatenated into a URL, then fetched by the server without destination checks.
candidates.evidence: No JavaScript SSRF Rule exists. Route /research is registered for logged-in users; no URL allowlist is present in this handler.

candidates.evidence: No redirect allowlist is visible in the route and no Open Redirect Rule exists.
